Subject: SOC 2 Type II or interim bridge for PO approval

Sergio / Marissa,

Quick note from procurement — we are at final legal review and need a SOC 2 Type II report that covers at least Jan 2026 - Dec 2026. If a full Type II report isn’t available, our legal team will accept a signed bridge letter / interim attestation tied to the most recent Type I plus evidence that the Type II audit is in progress.

Can you confirm by EOD 2027-05-05 whether Redwood can provide either: 1) a finalized Type II report covering the Jan–Dec 2026 period, or 2) an interim bridge letter plus a named list of artifacts we can rely on for procurement?

We’re trying to get the PO executed this week — otherwise the procurement window slips and the deal moves to next quarter.

Thanks,
Linda Chang
Director, Strategic Sourcing
Orion Health

Marissa — forwarding Orion’s ask (below). This is a hard close window: legal needs either the Type II (Jan–Dec 2026) or a bridge/interim attestation signed by an exec by 2027-05-06 to greenlight the PO.

Quick summary of options I see:
- Fast-track bridge letter: security drafts an interim attestation + named artifacts; legal signs and we deliver an auditor-stamped timeline if audit in progress. Target: 48–72 hours to draft + exec sign.
- Pull the Type II report if it exists for the requested period (unlikely we already have it).
- Offer a timeboxed remediation plan tied to auditor confirmation — higher friction.

Ask: can Security prioritize a bridge letter for Orion and confirm the required artifacts? Also, need a headcount/contract budget sign to assign an extra compliance engineer if necessary (Marissa / Kim — can we reallocate ~0.5 FTE for the next week?). I’ll update HubSpot (RDW-DEAL-2027-0843) as we land on an approach.

Appreciate quick replies; this is a strategic account and we should avoid slipping the PO.

> Marissa — forwarding Orion’s ask (below). This is a hard close window...

We can produce an interim bridge/attestation letter tied to our most recent Type I + evidence bundle, and we can provide a signed executive attestation. Conditions and constraints:
- Bridge letter (draft) can be ready in 48–72 hours if we prioritize and have auditor confirmation that Type II audit is in progress or recently completed.
- Complete Type II report generation is not feasible in 48 hours — it requires auditor deliverables and formal report turnaround (typically weeks).
- Required artifacts to include with the bridge (high level): control mappings, SOC environment list, recent penetration test summary, change control logs (Jan–Dec 2026), incident response zip, and auditor correspondence confirming audit window. I’ve attached the evidence checklist and a bridge letter template.

Immediate asks for Sales/ICs:
1) Confirm whether Orion will accept a bridge + artifact bundle + auditor note (I’ll draft language).
2) Confirm approver for exec attestation signature (legal/CEO/Head of Ops — we’ll need a named signer).
3) Approve short-term bandwidth (0.5–1.0 FTE) to scrub/assemble artifacts and run a 48–72 hour evidence sprint.

If approved, I’ll:
- Kick off a focused evidence sprint (internal-only channel)
- Draft the bridge attestation and circulate for legal + exec signature
- Coordinate with Crowe (audit@crowe-llp.com) to confirm the audit status and include a short auditor confirmation note if available.
